tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and settings groups.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, set cells, secondary buttons, chips.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed states, ring tracks, the mini bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px card borders and list dividers.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, hints, the previous set.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: column heads, disabled.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime. The one action or state that matters: primary buttons, done sets, the active tab, a closed ring. Never decoration.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or an icon on surface (darker in light so it reads).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: nudges, selected options.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Always-dark surfaces in both themes: the tab bar, hero and celebration cards.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Fasting: the Fast ring, fast pills in the calendar.

tokens.name: ring-move
tokens.usage: The Move ring (workout minutes). Darker lime in light so the ring holds on white.

tokens.name: ring-z2
tokens.usage: Zone 2: the weekly Zone 2 ring and label.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Personal records, milestones, weigh-ins.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind record and milestone badges.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Behind pace, too hard, stalled. A state, never a brand colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete, discard, an exercise that hurt.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

families.display: "Space Grotesk", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero-number
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about: a fast, body weight, a celebration.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Routine and exercise names, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start a fast when you finish eating.
styles.usage: Default UI text and inputs (16px+ so iOS never zooms).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase card eyebrows and column heads (set uppercase in CSS).

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: Your warm-up took most of the time. Here is a 30-minute version.

styles.name: read-list
styles.sample: Goblet Squat · One-Arm Dumbbell Row · Dumbbell Floor Press
styles.usage: Exercise lists in routine cards, checklist items, hints.

spacing.note: A 4px scale, plus 2 and 6 for tight control internals. Use the layout roles first; round up, never down.

tokens.name: sp-0-5
tokens.usage: Tight control internals only (tag padding, hairline offsets).

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside small chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: sp-1-5
tokens.usage: Inside a superset block; small chip padding.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in buttons; gaps in dense rows.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Default gap inside a card and between sibling cards.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter; gap between screen blocks; between superset blocks.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding, generous groups.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: sp-10
tokens.usage: Large empty states.

tokens.name: sp-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen edge, left and right.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card.

tokens.name: gap-in-card
tokens.usage: Between things inside a card.

tokens.name: gap-list
tokens.usage: Between sibling cards in a list.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen (a section title starts 32px below the previous block).

radius.note: Concentric: an inner radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Bars, tiny marks.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small chips.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, set cells, list rows, set number badges.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Inner panels, toasts.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Cards (the default card radius).

tokens.name: r-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, superset blocks, the fasting card.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, chips, the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: sheets, toasts, the tab bar, the mini bar. Cards use a 1px line, not a shadow.

size.note: Touch targets: 44px minimum for anything you tap mid-workout.

tokens.name: h-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary chips and tags only.

tokens.name: h-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: h-lg
tokens.usage: The primary action on a screen.

tokens.name: set-row
tokens.usage: One set in the workout table.

tokens.name: set-input
tokens.usage: Weight and reps cells.
